pages.title: A Dragon's Heartbeat
pages.text: A dragon heart answers the pulse of a living dragon, preserving the potions' power within the pendant. Its wearer fights harder at close quarters, with faster, more sustained claw attacks in human form.

pages.title: Closing on Prey
pages.text: Melee damage increases by 10%% in either form. In human form, the dragon favors close combat, strikes faster with its claws and has a 20%% shorter tail-sweep cooldown. It can still use breath and roars once that opportunity passes. It cannot be worn with Rending Claw or the Hunter King Pendant.
